newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Camet sees exports rising 8.5 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Camet sees exports rising 8.5 pct in 1997.

text.p: Peru's exports will grow by 8.5 percent to $6.4 billion in 1997 and by about 10 percent annually until the year 2000, Economy Minister Jorge Camet said on Thursday.
"We estimate that exports will reach $6.4 billion (in 1997) and will keep growing by 10 percent annually until the year 2000," Camet told legislators during a Congressional hearing.
From $8.3 billion in 2000, exports would grow to more than $14 billion by 2005, Camet said.
Peru's exports totalled $5.897 billion in 1996, according to Central Reserve Bank figures.
